titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦庄襄王二年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals of Qin for the second year of King Zhuangxiang: Meng Ao's campaign against Zhao and the settling of Taiyuan.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Qin and Chu.
The Hereditary Houses of Yan and of Zhao for this year: Qin's taking of Yuci and thirty-seven Fortresses, told from both sides, and Zhao's army sent to help Wei against Yan.
